query:
SELECT b._key, JSON_VALUE(b.payload,'$.id') AS source_project_id,
 JSON_VALUE(b.payload,'$.name') AS project_name, JSON_VALUE(b.payload,'$.active') AS is_active,
 b._ingested_at, b._batch_id
FROM [CD_Bronze_Lakehouse].[dbo].[cd_bronze_procore_projects] b
LEFT JOIN dbo.cd_silver_projects s ON JSON_VALUE(b.payload,'$.id') = s.project_id
WHERE s.project_id IS NULL
